purpose: Reusable non-authorizing components for AI/session coordination ingress and defensive containment of ungoverned AI at StegVerse-controlled consequence boundaries.

preconditions: no runtime identity claim inferred from declaration
expected_evidence: runtime identity attestation remains separately classified
components.authority_owner: Task Registry coordination policy only; no execution authority
components.retry_or_reentry_semantics: FAIL_CLOSED; preserve evidence; re-enter only with corrected canonical coordination inputs; component receipt grants no later authority

credential isolation or explicitly capability-scoped credential policy
outputs: bounded AI work result or proposed consequence
denied-consequence proof where a consequence is rejected
governed egress candidate with no component-local authority
explicit denied Task Registry and protected-authority reachability
preconditions: non-ChatGPT or otherwise ungoverned AI interaction crosses a StegVerse-controlled consequence boundary
protected resources have no alternate direct path through this component
capability scope is materialized before execution
ambient host credentials and authority-bearing state are absent
any credential exposure is separately issued and capability-scoped by the canonical credential owner

external AI internal reasoning, model policy, memory, and implementation remain outside StegVerse authority
expected_evidence: source contract enumerating controlled chokepoints and capability ceilings
credential absence or exact capability-scoped issuance evidence

denied-consequence proof showing consumed=false and consequence_reachable=false where the selected boundary supports those predicates
evidence retention for request, boundary policy, proposed consequence, disposition, and released result without claiming hidden model state

representative runtime boundary admission and denial evidence
components.authority_owner: No component-local state-transition authority. External AI remains sovereign internally; WorkerCoordinator, TV/TVC, Interlock/InTr, Master Records, Publisher, and other canonical owners retain their existing authority.
components.retry_or_reentry_semantics: FAIL_CLOSED at the controlled consequence boundary; preserve boundary evidence; remediate the first concrete capability, credential, reachability, evidence, or egress defect; re-enter only after the same boundary is revalidated.
